drhp.business: Can Fin Homes Limited is a housing finance company primarily engaged in providing loans for the purchase, construction, and renovation of residential properties to individuals. The company operates through a network of branches across India, serving salaried and self-employed customers in the affordable and mid-income housing segments. It also accepts public deposits and raises funds through debt securities and bank borrowings to finance its lending operations.
drhp.end_markets: Affordable and mid-income housing segment in India|Salaried and self-employed individuals across multiple Indian states

sk.overview: India's digital financial services and NBFC-led retail lending sector serves a large, young, credit-underpenetrated mass market. Formalization (GST, JAM/India Stack, eKYC), rising smartphone/internet penetration and low data costs are enabling tech-led NBFCs and fintechs to underwrite and serve borrowers that conventional banks have historically underserved, particularly in unsecured personal loans and loan-against-property.
